class AudioRecorderManager {

    static let shared = AudioRecorderManager()
    private init() {}
    
    var isRecording: Bool = false
    var hasFinished: Bool = false
    
    // AVAudioEngine properties
    private let engine = AVAudioEngine()
    private let inputNode = AVAudioInputNode()
    private let outputNode = AVAudioOutputNode()
    private let recorder = AVAudioRecorder()

    private var baseAddress: UnsafeMutableRawPointer?

        try audioSession.setActive(true)
        
        // Setup Engine Nodes

            self?.processBuffer(buffer)
        }
        
        // Setup Visualizer Nodes
        setupEqualizer()
        
        // Setup Recorder
        setupRecorder()
        
        engine.start()
        
        DispatchQueue.main.async {
            self.isRecording = true
            self.hasFinished = false
        }
    }
    
    func stop() {
        guard isRecording else { return }
        
        engine.stop()
        DispatchQueue.main.async {
            self.isRecording = false
            self.hasFinished = false
        }
    }
    
    func finish() {
        stop()
        saveRecording()
        DispatchQueue.main.async {
            self.hasFinished = true
        }
    }
    
    // MARK: - Private Implementation
    
    private func setupRecorder() {
        recorder.delegate = self
        recorder.allowsConcurrentRecording = true
        
        // Create URL for saving
        let documentsDir = FileManager.default.urls(for: .documentDirectory, in: .userDomainMask)[0]
        let fileURL = documentsDir.appendingPathComponent("recording_\(Date().timeIntervalSince1970).wav")

        recorder.shouldLoopBack = false

        recorder.format = engine.mainMixerPort.format
        recorder.numberOfChannels = engine.mainMixerPort.format.channelCount
        recorder.fileType = .wav

        for i in 0..<3 {
            let node = AVAudioEffect(name: "EQ", parameters: EQParameters(bands: 3))

        // Update Visualizer

            visualizer.update(with: buffer)

import Foundation
import AVFoundation
import UIKit

class AudioRecorderManager {
    
    // MARK: - Properties
    static let shared = AudioRecorderManager()
    private init() {}
    
    var isRecording: Bool = false
    var hasFinished: Bool = false
    
    // AVAudioEngine properties
    private let engine = AVAudioEngine()
    private let inputNode = AVAudioInputNode()
    private let outputNode = AVAudioOutputNode()
    private let recorder = AVAudioRecorder()
    
    // Equalizer Nodes
    private var equalizerNodes: [AVAudioNode] = []
    private var visualizer: AVAudioVisualizer?
    
    // Data buffers
    private var bufferQueue: DispatchQueue?
    private var baseAddress: UnsafeMutableRawPointer?
    
    // MARK: - Lifecycle
    
    func start() throws {
        guard !isRecording else { return }
        
        // Configure Audio Session
        let audioSession = AVAudioSession.sharedInstance()
        try audioSession.setCategory(.playAndRecord, mode: .default, options: [.mixWithOthers])
        try audioSession.setActive(true)
        
        // Setup Engine Nodes
        engine.inputNode.installTap(onBus: 0, bufferSize: 1024, format: nil) { [weak self] buffer, time in
            self?.processBuffer(buffer)
        }
        
        // Setup Visualizer Nodes
        setupEqualizer()
        
        // Setup Recorder
        setupRecorder()
        
        engine.start()
        
        DispatchQueue.main.async {
            self.isRecording = true
            self.hasFinished = false
        }
    }
    
    func stop() {
        guard isRecording else { return }
        
        engine.stop()
        DispatchQueue.main.async {
            self.isRecording = false
            self.hasFinished = false
        }
    }
    
    func finish() {
        stop()
        saveRecording()
        DispatchQueue.main.async {
            self.hasFinished = true
        }
    }
    
    // MARK: - Private Implementation
    
    private func setupRecorder() {
        recorder.delegate = self
        recorder.allowsConcurrentRecording = true
        
        // Create URL for saving
        let documentsDir = FileManager.default.urls(for: .documentDirectory, in: .userDomainMask)[0]
        let fileURL = documentsDir.appendingPathComponent("recording_\(Date().timeIntervalSince1970).wav")
        
        recorder.outputFileURL = fileURL
        recorder.isMuted = false
        recorder.shouldLoopBack = false
        recorder.sampleRate = engine.mainMixerPort.sampleRate
        recorder.format = engine.mainMixerPort.format
        recorder.numberOfChannels = engine.mainMixerPort.format.channelCount
        recorder.fileType = .wav
        
        recorder.prepareToRecord()
    }
    
    private func setupEqualizer() {
        // Create nodes for each band (Low, Mid, High)
        for i in 0..<3 {
            let node = AVAudioEffect(name: "EQ", parameters: EQParameters(bands: 3))
            node.install()
            
            if i == 0 {
                engine.inputNode.insert(node, at: 1)
            } else if i == 2 {
                engine.mainMixerPort.insert(node, at: 1)
            } else {
                node.install() // Connect middle band implicitly by order or explicitly
            }
            
            equalizerNodes.append(node)
        }
        
        // Create Visualizer
        visualizer = AVAudioVisualizer(numBands: 3)
        visualizer!.install()
        visualizer!.connect(engine.mainMixerPort, onBus: 0)
    }
    
    private func processBuffer(_ buffer: AVAudioPCMBuffer) {
        // Update Visualizer
        if let visualizer = visualizer {
            visualizer.update(with: buffer)
        }
        
        // Record to File
        recorder.record(buffer)
    }
    
    private func saveRecording() {
        guard let url = recorder.outputFileURL else { return }
        do {
            try recorder.startWriting()
            try recorder.finishWriting()
            print("Recording saved to: \(url)")
        } catch {
            print("Failed to save recording: \(error)")
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - AVAudioRecorderDelegate
extension AudioRecorderManager: AVAudioRecorderDelegate {
    func audioRecorderDidFinishRecording(_ recorder: AVAudioRecorder, successfully flag: Bool) {
        DispatchQueue.main.async {
            self.isRecording = false
            if flag {
                self.hasFinished = true
            }
        }
    }
    
    func audioRecorderEncodeErrorDidOccur(_ recorder: AVAudioRecorder, error: Error?) {
        DispatchQueue.main.async {
            self.isRecording = false
            self.hasFinished = true
            print("Encoding error: \(error?.localizedDescription ?? "Unknown")")
        }
    }
}

}

    *   Clear status text indicates what is happening.
